text.tspan: J_(k-1): cheapest way here from the start
J_k(j) includes this cell's F_k(j) dt
B_(k+1): cheapest way from here to the end
B = 0, goal term is in F here
J_k(j) + B_k(j) = cheapest whole path through (k, j), this cell counted once.
The smallest of these over all cells j equals the plan's cost, at every k.
the forward pass pays this cell
+ F_(k+1)(j + delta) dt + 1/2 w v^2 dt
the backward pass pays the next cell, not this one
